name: Tried Bob on my hardware
about: Tell us how Bob went on your hardware tier (a small card, built-in graphics, processor only, a Mac, a Pi or anything we don't have)
labels: hardware report
---

**Hardware tier:** (from the README's "Set up for your hardware" table: 16 GB card, 12 GB or bigger, 8 GB, 6 GB, built-in graphics, processor only, Raspberry Pi or ARM)

**Machine:** (kind of computer, OS and version, processor, graphics card and its memory, RAM. No serial numbers or computer names.)

**Bob version:** (footer of his window)

**Bob's defaults kept?** (yes / no; if no, which settings you changed)

**Brain:** (the name on the Brains page)

**Speed:** (the brain label shows tokens a second after a reply; a short chat and a long paste if you tried both)

**What worked**


**What didn't** (the exact message Bob showed, if any)


**Help bundle:** (optional: Settings, This replicant matrix and updates, Save a help bundle. Names, folders, keys and addresses are taken out; look it over before you attach it.)
